title: Mesh Generator Configuration Schema
description: External configuration parameters used by the Mesh Generator to produce the CFD-ready grid, mask, and boundary conditions.

tolerance.description: Geometric tolerance used during STEP parsing, surface reconstruction, and point-in-solid classification.

max_element_size.description: Maximum allowed mesh element size used when computing grid resolution.

min_element_size.description: Minimum allowed mesh element size used when computing grid resolution.

boundary_map.description: Defines the mapping between spatial boundary locations (domain extents or internal walls) and physical condition types.

x_min.description: Condition type for the negative X domain boundary.

x_max.description: Condition type for the positive X domain boundary.

y_min.description: Condition type for the negative Y domain boundary.

y_max.description: Condition type for the positive Y domain boundary.

z_min.description: Condition type for the negative Z domain boundary.

z_max.description: Condition type for the positive Z domain boundary.

wall.description: Default condition type for internal structural interfaces (non-boundary).
